supported_scope: Flat ASCII JSON integer values 0..99999, exact raw byte spans and absent keys, key lengths 2..7, context <=128 bytes. External mode routing; unsupported types not admitted.
scope: No training, original checkpoint plus sealed D3C native grounded and D4B byte relative. Fresh heldout 512 pairs (1024 queries), normal, raw mixed whitespace, normalized mixed whitespace, reorder, absent, changed values, erased query, deleted context, direct-copy reference. Separate stress on longer strings/IDs, no promotion. Guard verifies equality to cited original bytes, not factual correctness.
